name: Nonlinear Conductivity Filter
definition: A variation of nonlinear conductivity that uses signed forward differences instead of gradient magnitude to control diffusion direction, favoring diffusion towards the medial axis and preventing edge crossing.
summary: The Nonlinear Conductivity Filter improves scale detection in volume rendering by using signed differences to direct diffusion toward the medial axis, preventing the false maxima caused by the Perona-Malik filter.
